diagnosis: The Robyn worker inspection route accepts tenant_id in the URL path and returns worker thread allocation, active concurrency limits, and pending task queue depth. It does not check whether request.identity belongs to tenant_id or has system administrative privileges, allowing tenants to monitor each other's operational load and server capacity.
exploit_request:
GET /admin/workers/pools/tenant_competitor_org/status HTTP/1.1
Host: robyn-cluster.cloud.internal
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
